thread:
acme-infra: Hi team — starting ~09:12 UTC we saw a flurry of 400s from our calls to /v1/generate?mode=structured. Errors say: "Invalid JSON output: missing required key 'session_id'". This started right after traffic spiked and we saw a model fallback in the headers.
maya_s: ack — do you have example response body? any raw payloads?
acme-infra: here's a truncated response we logged from the failing call:
```json
{"status":"ok","payload": {"user": "alice", "events": []}}
```
Note: no session_id key. Our schema requires {session_id, user, events}.
eli_g: linking to the support trace: <https://app.support/INC-4821> — I can see the request headers show `x-redwood-variant: quantized-v2` after the first retries.
zoe_ops: interesting — the baseline model (non-quantized) always includes session_id in the template. Did smart-routing fall back to a variant with an older instruction/template?
andrew_runtime: from runtime logs: fallback occurred because dedicated pool hit a transient OOM, then smart router routed to cheaper pool with `quantized-v2` which was marked compatible. Looks like `quantized-v2` has a different structured-output prompt profile.
acme-infra: this is breaking production parsing — we have no tolerance for missing keys. Customer-facing errors are cascading. Can we pin the endpoint to a model or disable fallbacks?
maya_s: temporary mitigation: you can set `fallback: false` in the route config or pin `model: redwood/base:2025-11` in the request. Will send docs snippet.
eng-infra-bot: FYI automated guardrail fired for route: structured.schemas.enforced=true, but fallback whitelist contains quantized-v2.
eli_g: short term: disable fallback for the route and roll back to the variant that matches the structured template. Medium: add a compatibility test in the rollout pipeline that verifies required JSON keys for structured endpoints. Long term: we should include schema fingerprints in variant metadata and make smart-routing respect them.
zoe_ops: repro steps I used locally:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?mode=structured -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"prompt":"{schema:session_v1}"}'
2) overload dedicated pool with synthetic traffic to trigger fallback
3) observe header `x-redwood-variant: quantized-v2` and missing `session_id` in response
eli_g: logs attached in the support ticket include route config, header traces, and response diffs.
andrew_runtime: root cause hypothesis: quantized-v2 ships with an older prompt template that doesn't emit session_id by default; runtime compatibility check currently only verifies tokenization and shape, not structured key set.
maya_s: action items: @andrew_runtime escalate to runtime team to add schema fingerprint check; @eli_g add a KB entry for customers about pinning and disabling fallback for structured endpoints; @zoe_ops coordinate with Acme for immediate roll-back.
acme-infra: thanks — we'll flip fallback off for this route and monitor. Any ETA for the fingerprint check?
andrew_runtime: putting a hotfix on deck — ETA 48 hours to add a whitelist-based response schema validator in the router. Will post PR link.
zoe_ops: adding :eyes: — please post the PR and I'll verify with Acme before the patch goes live.
acme-infra: appreciated. also seeing a small billing diff due to extra retries; raising a separate ticket to support for credits.
maya_s: noted, tagging billing. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
